title: Двадцать тысяч за полтинник  (Twenty Thousand for a Fifty-Ruble Bill)

segments.t: As the evening ends, Denis wonders why men never understand what women want. Seeing Denis nursing a bruised eye from the police raid, Katya feels guilty and gently tends to his face. When Denis later receives his marked fifty-ruble bill in change at a bar, he pays the bartender twenty thousand rubles to hand the note to Katya so she will believe in fate.
Главная проблема мужчин всегда была очень простой.
Мы совсем не знаем, чего хотят женщины.
Возможно, им просто нравится долго мучить нас.
Ой, Денис, какая же я всё-таки бессердечная!
Или они хотят иногда видеть нас слабыми.
Тогда они могут жалеть нас и заботиться.
Дочка, похоже, твоё молекулярное шоу отлично удалось!
Денис, ну что тебе опять от меня нужно?
Сколько раз повторять, между нами ничего нет?
Возьми двадцать тысяч и передай ей этот полтинник!
Только смотри, никому не говори про наш уговор!
Я думаю, женщины просто хотят настоящей любви.
Let's examine the closing reflections on love and Denis's romantic gesture.
Главная проблема мужчин всегда была очень простой.
'The main problem of men has always been very simple.' Saying that the main problem of men has always been very simple is how Denis sets the tone with Barinov.
Мы совсем не знаем, чего хотят женщины.
'We do not know at all what women want.' Once they do not know at all what women want, Denis can finally tell Barinov what he means.
Возможно, им просто нравится долго мучить нас.
'Perhaps they simply like tormenting us for a long time.' Around the plan and police, Denis sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
Ой, Денис, какая же я всё-таки бессердечная!
'Oh, Denis, how heartless I really am!' Over the police and the moment, Katya lets her real feelings show. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.
Или они хотят иногда видеть нас слабыми.
'Or they want to see us weak sometimes.' Here wanting to see them weak sometimes sets up the next turn in their exchange.
Тогда они могут жалеть нас и заботиться.
'Then they can pity us and take care of us.' Mentioning that they can pity them and take care of them moves the talk in a new direction.
Дочка, похоже, твоё молекулярное шоу отлично удалось!

'Daughter, it looks like your molecular show succeeded splendidly!' Barinov insists that daughter it looks like Denis's molecular show succeeded splendidly, leaving Denis no room to argue. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Денис, ну что тебе опять от меня нужно?

'Denis, well what do you need from me again?' Wondering what Barinov needs from her again is how Katya puts Barinov on the spot. There is no "you" needed in the Russian here: one short word states the rule for everyone in the room.
Сколько раз повторять, между нами ничего нет?
'How many times must you repeat that there is nothing between us?' Denis asks whether how many times must Barinov repeats that there is nothing between them, refusing to let the point slide.
Возьми двадцать тысяч и передай ей этот полтинник!

'Take twenty thousand and hand her this fifty-ruble bill!' Saying that Barinov should take twenty thousand and hand her this fifty ruble bill is how Denis takes charge of the moment. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Только смотри, никому не говори про наш уговор!

'Just make sure you do not tell anyone about our deal!' Insisting that just make sure Barinov does not tell anyone about their deal shows Denis is not backing down. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Я думаю, женщины просто хотят настоящей любви.

'I think women simply want real love.' Realizing that she thinks women simply want real love changes how Katya handles the situation. Now listen to the final scene of the episode from start to finish.

Sometimes even fate needs a little help—and women simply want genuine love and care. See you next time!
